en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large brick industrial complex beside a river. The multi‑storey mill buildings with gabled roofs and many arched windows stand behind trees, with a tall chimney visible. In the foreground, a bridge with a decorative metal railing crosses the river. Printed titles in German at the top identify the location as Northeim in Hanover and refer to the Rhume mill; along the left edge is the publisher information.
